property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() on the correct contract succeeds (does not revert) iff msg.sender == owner; the mutant inverts the check so owned() instead succeeds for non-owners and reverts for the owner, breaking that rule for many caller addresses.
change_summary: Replace the require check in onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the guard so owned() can be called by non-owners and leaving owner unchanged (observable difference because calls by original owner will revert but non-owner calls succeed).
